policy.route: Full geometry macro routing is disclosed. Only current visible enemies/facing and rendered paint/air positions affect local avoidance. Green cells query visibility first; paint memory30s/air1.2s, soft cost40. No hidden patrol/hazard phase/future drops read. Short back-facing corridor allowed, reobserve350ms. Same original observed-chaos retreat threshold.
policy.offer: Vacant slots: publicly canOffer contaminants sorted by explicit damage-reduction percentage in description, then first legal. No hidden catalog profile used. Existing offerings retained.
policy.repair: After return, purifier/core below50 restored toward50, storage below50 toward50; bring storage to100 only if full cost affordable. Actual E/arrow/Enter payment; no free repair.
policy.growth: When storage100 and all modules>=50, real next displayed unlocked node only; initial three nodes vitality/affinity/defense slot, no skip. Purchase only with reserve remaining >= max(4, latest actual impact repair bill at4HP/fuel). Actual station and Enter.

limits: Only completed real-input records are counted; failed and pending attempts retained.
Full-map geometry and node positions aid macro routing; micro decisions use disclosed visible projections. This is not a human blind playtest.
An actual saved-state branch does not make its previous seven journeys new income and cannot be pooled into the original natural cohort.
No death in a sample cannot prove death recovery or expected value. No claim of optimal play or long-term balance follows from one phase.
